What is the difference between a Shopify plugin and a Shopify app?
Answer
People often use both words for the same thing. A plugin usually means a small add-on feature for your store, such as a theme extension or section. A Shopify app can be larger, has its own admin screens and can serve many stores. We help you pick the lighter option that does the job.

Can you build a plugin for my existing theme?
Answer
Yes. We build plugins for most themes, including Online Store 2.0 themes, and test them on a duplicate of your theme first.

Will a custom plugin slow down my store?
Answer
A custom plugin carries only the code it needs, so it is usually lighter than a ready-made app. We also check the speed of your store before and after.

Can my team manage the plugin without a developer?

How long does a Shopify plugin take to build?

A small plugin can take a few days, while larger ones with settings and integrations take longer. We give you a clear timeline after we understand what you need.

Questions
Brand Development Questions We Often Hear
01
What is brand development?
−
Brand development is the complete process of building a brand: research, positioning, name and story, logo and visual identity, communication, brand guidelines and the launch. It is much more than logo design.
02
What is the difference between brand development and logo design?
+
A logo is one part of a brand. Brand development covers the strategy behind the logo, the name, the voice, the visual identity system, the stationery, the digital and packaging design, the brand book and the launch.
03
Who needs brand development services?
+
Any new business, startup or company that wants to launch a website, a mobile app or a software product as a brand, and any existing business that needs a brand refresh or rebranding.
04
What does We3vision deliver in a brand development project?
+
Depending on the package: brand research and strategy, name and tagline, logo and logo variations, typography and colours, stationery, social media templates, brand guidelines, packaging, website or app branding and a launch kit. Deliverables and revisions are written in the project scope and contract.
05
Can you do only a part of the brand?
+
Yes. We offer a starter, a complete and a premium brand package, and individual services such as brand strategy, logo design, brand kit design, packaging or a brand launch.
06
Do you also build the website or app for my brand?
+
Yes. We3vision is a design and development company, so we can brand your product and also build the website, mobile app or software that carries the brand.
07
Do you work on rebranding?
+
Yes. We audit your existing brand and then refresh the logo, identity, messaging, packaging, website and guidelines, with a plan to introduce the change.
08
Do you offer social media management?
+
Our brand development includes social media branding: templates, profile design and guidelines. Daily posting, content calendars and community management are offered as a separate service.

What is the difference between SEO and AEO?
−
SEO helps search engines find, understand and rank your pages. AEO shapes the same content so that clear, well-supported answers are easier for answer systems to interpret and possibly surface. They overlap heavily: helpful content and a healthy website help both.
How long can SEO take to show results?
+
It depends on the competition, the condition of the site, the quality of the content and how often changes are made. Some technical fixes show effects sooner, while content and authority usually take longer to build. We do not promise a fixed timeline.
Can you optimize an existing website?
+
Yes. We start with an assessment of the current site, then fix what holds it back and improve what already works, without rebuilding it unless that is really needed.
Do you provide technical SEO and content SEO?
+
Yes. Technical SEO, on-page work, keyword research, content strategy and optimization, local SEO and AEO are all part of our scope, depending on what your site needs.
Can you help improve AI search visibility?
+
We can help you make your information clearer, more consistent and easier to crawl, which can make it more eligible to be used in AI-generated answers. No one can guarantee inclusion in them.
How is SEO progress measured?
+
Where tracking is set up, we look at organic clicks and impressions, query performance, indexed pages, landing-page engagement and relevant conversions, and we keep activity metrics separate from business outcomes.
Do you guarantee search rankings?
+
No. Rankings depend on competition, technical condition, content quality, authority and many other factors, some of which we do not control. We commit to careful, ethical work and clear reporting, not to a ranking position.
